title: A to-do alert that is never handled quietly leaves the bell after 30 days
what: The bell promises that a thing to do (a member question, a plan request, a message) stays in the main list until it is done. But every alert is deleted 30 days after it was written, and the bell list only looks at the last 30 days. So a member question nobody answered in a month drops off the bell and its number goes down, with nothing in History and no word why, while Today and the member's page still show it waiting. The bell and Today then give two different counts of what is waiting.
expected: A thing to do stays on the bell (or at least in History, marked as still waiting) until it is done, so the bell number matches what Today shows as waiting.
fix_line: Keep unfinished to-do alerts past 30 days, or show them as still waiting

title: In a check-in challenge a member who comes daily can see 0 visits with no reason
what: The check-in challenge counts a member's visits only through the number the app checked in with. When two app members share one number (a family on one phone) both count 0 on purpose, and a member who has never scanned the gym's code with the app also counts 0. The member's card then says '0 of 20 visits' although the gym's own visit register shows them coming every day, and nothing tells them why or what to do (ask the desk to put their own number on the list, or scan once).
expected: When a member's visits cannot be counted, the challenge card says why and what fixes it, instead of a plain 0.
fix_line: Send a reason with the member's number and show it on the card
